_comment: The CPU rehearsal of the Kimi-K3.1 sampler node (tests/test_rl_k31_e2e_cpu.py): the fake
engine returns the K3-4layer shape of the K3.1 rollout fields (R3 routed experts
uint16[T, 3, 16] below 896 with 0xFFFF pads, 128 top-K log-probs, fp32 lm-head) and takes
a release's changed expert files through the k31_release plan. Paths in angle brackets
are local scratch directories. Run: python -m yeto.rl.engine.engine_sampler --spec THIS.json
